title: Still Learning
tagline: Why machines that keep learning slowly lose the ability to learn, and how a fresh start fixes it.
description: A ten-part documentary investigation into one PhD thesis. Today's neural networks learn once and then freeze. Ask them to keep learning and they gradually lose the ability to learn at all. Correspondent Miriam Okafor and explainers Dev Raman and Lucía Ferreira follow the evidence through toy experiments, forty years of missed warnings, and a cure: periodically giving small parts of the network a fresh start. Every section, figure and equation of the thesis is covered, and each episode comes with a full transcript and show notes.
